text: {"name":"sdio_core_reset_config","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Clears the SDIO core control register, programs auxiliary and core configuration bitfields, and enables the core interface.","subsystem":"hal","var_renames":{"v0":"sdio_core_base","v2":"cfg_pres_mask_1","v3":"cfg_pres_mask_2","result":"old_core_cfg"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Core control/reset register cleared to 0"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Core enable register written 1"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Core control bitfield with bit 25 set"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Core configuration register updated twice with fixed fields"},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Auxiliary register programmed with 0x128 (296)"}]}
